notes: Jacobs facing a likely suspension (pending NFL review) plus a groin issue. Lloyd has handled starter reps in Jacobs absence but has his own injury history (hamstring, preseason 2026). Packers may carry 4 RBs (Jacobs, Lloyd, Chris Brooks, Pierre Strong) -- Brooks is a real threat to vulture passing-down work if Lloyds workload increases, so this is not a clean one-for-one succession. Treat Lloyd pickups with a caveat about Brooks.
